mapper.select: SELECT * FROM EVENT_TEMPLATE ORDER BY TEMPLATE_ID

SELECT TFR, UNEMPLOYMENT_RATE, NET_MIGRATION_RATE, LIFE_EXPECTANCY FROM COUNTRY_STAT WHERE COUNTRY_CODE = #{countryCode} AND DECADE = LEAST(#{decade}, (SELECT MAX(DECADE) FROM COUNTRY_STAT WHERE COUNTRY_CODE = #{countryCode}))

SELECT G.* FROM GAME_EVENT G JOIN EVENT_TEMPLATE T ON G.TEMPLATE_ID = T.TEMPLATE_ID WHERE G.EVENT_TYPE = 'LIFE' AND G.TEMPLATE_ID = #{templateId} AND #{age} BETWEEN NVL(G.MIN_AGE, T.MIN_AGE) AND NVL(G.MAX_AGE, T.MAX_AGE) AND #{wealth} BETWEEN NVL(G.MIN_WEALTH, 1) AND NVL(G.MAX_WEALTH, 5) AND NVL(G.GENDER, #{gender}) = #{gender}
SELECT EXP_ID FROM LIFE_EXPERIENCE WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId}
SELECT SENTENCE FROM EVENT_TEXT WHERE TEMPLATE_ID = #{templateId}
SELECT NAME_KO FROM COUNTRY WHERE COUNTRY_CODE = #{countryCode}
